status: Editorial foundation; source cue constraints added after v11 lyric audit failed
reason: Owner rejected static presentation staging and required visible scene changes every few seconds. Sequence work precedes detail work.
cutTiming: Source clause boundaries before musical retiming
rules: Every shot changes the visible setup or action, not merely its title or an imperceptible zoom.
Cut on an action, cause/consequence, point of view, reveal, or match; no arbitrary slideshow succession.
Rough-cut the whole sequence before polishing objects or commissioning more assets.
New images are source material, never proof that animation or integration is complete.
Preserve original words and audio; do not invent lyrics during instrumental passages.
